mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 90 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall, and the moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

In city news, the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture has officially been installed at Century School. Also, residents are reminded to check the city website for information regarding the upcoming November general election and sample ballots.

There is plenty to do, with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia both happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia fun at The Bogey Factory.
On Friday, August 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle accident on South Nine Mound Road where a driver was cited for inattentive driving after striking a parked vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a sweet treat.
